 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 28 October 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your mind, heart and soul are all ready for a fresh start. Sag , you are waiting with bated breath for something to conspire and be born out of this situation. Chaos and conflict may feel like an undercurrent, not so much externally but more in your mind. You may feel unable to make your way through something because of a lack of clarity. But you know that this fog will lift and you are looking forward to that first break of dawn on the horizon.
 Cosmic tip: Observe your situation to find that end that helps you detangle your ball of wool.
